name: Methi
actions: Supports healthy blood sugar in diet
kitchenUse: A teaspoon of seeds soaked overnight and eaten in the morning, or cooked into dal and vegetables.

cautions.note: Not safe in pregnancy in amounts above those in food; its use has been linked to birth defects.
Little is known about amounts above those in food while breastfeeding.
Food amounts are considered safe; larger amounts have not been shown to be safe for children.
Can cause allergic reactions, sometimes serious, and may cross-react with peanut or chickpea allergy.
Large amounts can lower blood sugar too far; monitor if you have diabetes.

interactions.effect: May lower blood sugar further; monitor closely.
May add to the effect of blood thinners.

evidence.summary: Studies suggest fenugreek may lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes, but many were not of high quality. Its effect on breast milk supply is uncertain.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
